limitations: Explicit dependency graph is incomplete; free-text copies, citation-only references and source dependence require manual follow-up/T-0672.
Accepted mention identity maps one occurrence to a person; one source occurrence does not prove the entire person identity rests solely on that source.
A source object may aggregate books or derived registers; multiple source objects can copy one another. Neither count proves independence.
Noncurrent basis revisions are traced as stored and flagged, never silently replaced with current payloads.
This is priority triage, no original reading and no new identity/pedigree acceptance.
No-link claims without citation provenance cannot be assigned source-reading ownership by invention; they remain explicit gaps for current-person scope/T-0672 follow-up.

method.sole_definition: graph_single_record means exactly one distinct record object reachable in this explicit graph. It is a concentration-risk flag, NOT confirmation of sole real-world support or independent source count.

method.traversal: Exact revision-bound supports/derived_from dependencies only; stop at record, person or source. Reject candidate/rejected/retired bases. Record one explicit path per reached record revision.
